require 'fileutils'
require 'pathname'
def export_logs(dir_name)
  base_path = Pathname.new("/var/log/debug/").realpath
  target_dir = Pathname.new(File.join(base_path, dir_name)).realpath
  unless target_dir.absolute? && target_dir.to_s.start_with?(base_path.to_s)
    return render json: { error: "Invalid directory" }, status: 403
  end
  files = Dir.entries(target_dir).select { |f| File.file?(File.join(target_dir, f)) }
  logs = {}
  files.each do |f|
    content = File.read(File.join(target_dir, f))
    logs[f] = content
  end
  render json: { files: logs }
end

def serve_media(request)
  filename = request.params[:file]
  base_dir = Rails.root.join('public', 'media')
  cleaned = filename.to_s.delete("\x00")
  path = File.join(base_dir, cleaned)
  resolved = Pathname.new(path).realpath
  base = Pathname.new(base_dir)
  unless resolved.cleanpath.to_s.start_with?(base.cleanpath.to_s)
    return render plain: 'Forbidden', status: 403
  end
  if File.exist?(path) && File.file?(path)
    send_file(path, type: 'audio/mp3', disposition: 'inline')
  else
    render plain: 'File not found', status: 404
  end
end

<?php
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\AccessDeniedHttpException;

function downloadBackupConfig(Request $request): BinaryFileResponse
{
    $profile = $request->query->get('profile', 'default');
    $safeProfile = basename($profile);
    $configPath = "/var/config/backups/{$safeProfile}.json";
    if (!file_exists($configPath)) {
        throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Profile not found');
    }
    $content = file_get_contents($configPath);
    file_put_contents("/tmp/download.json", $content);
    return new BinaryFileResponse("/tmp/download.json");
}

from django.http import HttpResponse, Http404
import os

def serve_static_asset(request):
    filename = request.GET.get('file', '')
    if '..' in filename or filename.startswith('/'):
        raise Http404("Invalid file name")
    base_dir = '/var/www/cdn/assets'
    filepath = os.path.join(base_dir, filename)
    if not os.path.abspath(filepath).startswith(base_dir):
        raise Http404("Invalid file path")
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        response = HttpResponse(f.read(), content_type='application/octet-stream')
        response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="{os.path.basename(filename)}"'
        return response
